column1: # Eclipse catalogue 2025-2045, transcribed from NASA GSFC eclipse.gsfc.nasa.gov
# Times are instant of greatest eclipse in TD; TD-UTC is ~70s this era, far inside
# the +/-6h effect window, so they are used directly as UTC.
# type: 0 partial solar, 1 annular, 2 total solar, 3 hybrid,
#       4 penumbral lunar, 5 partial lunar, 6 total lunar
# magnitude: umbral magnitude for lunar (negative for penumbral), eclipse magnitude for solar
